---
title: "Make Mouse gene_id mapping table"
output: html_notebook
---



```{r, setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '.')
```


```{r}
library(biomaRt)
```


```{r}
bm <- biomaRt::getBM(
  mart = biomaRt::useEnsembl('genes','hsapiens_gene_ensembl'),
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","entrezgene_id","hgnc_id","external_gene_name")
)
write.table(bm,file="geneid_map.tsv",sep="\t",row.names = FALSE)
```
